description.value: The Coriander Indian is a sit-down Indian restaurant located in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, steps from the Inner Harbour and Beacon Hill Park — a natural stop on popular cycling routes through the area. The restaurant seats up to 50 guests, offering a full dine-in experience in a compact neighbourhood setting.
